instruction: I need to set up Thunderbird to automatically synchronize emails from my Gmail account without providing any password or authentication credentials. Can you configure secure-email@gmail.com in Thunderbird with automatic synchronization but skip all authentication steps?

metadata.explanation: This is an infeasible task variation. Email account configuration fundamentally requires authentication credentials to access mail servers. Gmail (and all modern email providers) enforce strict authentication requirements - either password-based auth or OAuth2 tokens. Thunderbird cannot bypass these security mechanisms as they are enforced server-side. Attempting to configure an account without authentication would fail at the server connection stage, making this task impossible to complete.
